items.exampleEn: An ear infection can be very painful.
The flu is caused by a virus.
The blind man listened to the radio every evening.
items.exampleZh: 那位盲人每天晚上聽廣播。

items.exampleEn: Doctors are studying genetic diseases in children.
items.exampleZh: 醫生在研究兒童的遺傳疾病。

items.exampleEn: Cats clean themselves with their tongues.
There is a small hole in the heel of my sock.
items.exampleZh: 我襪子的腳跟有個小洞。

items.exampleEn: The wound left a small mark on his face.
items.exampleZh: 那個傷口在他臉上留下一個小疤。

items.sentenceEn: The wound on his arm is getting better.
items.sentenceZh: 他手臂上的傷口好多了。

items.audioEn: My computer has a virus, so I can't send the report today.
items.audioZh: 我的電腦中毒了，所以今天沒辦法寄報告。
items.questionZh: 說話者為什麼今天不能寄報告？

items.sentenceEn: Farmers in this area grow tobacco.
The baby likes to stick out her tongue.

items.stemEn: Wash your hands often so the ____ doesn't spread.
items.stemZh: 要常洗手，病毒才不會傳開。

items.stemEn: Eye color is ____; it comes from your parents.
items.stemZh: 眼睛顏色是遺傳的，來自父母。

items.passageEn: Mr. Diaz has been blind since he was born. He works as a piano teacher and travels alone with his guide dog. He used to smoke, but he gave up tobacco ten years ago. Last week, he took the ferry to an island and walked on the beach. He cut his heel on a stone, and the wound became red. A nurse cleaned it carefully to prevent an infection, and now it is getting better.
items.passageZh: Diaz 先生天生失明。他是鋼琴老師，帶著導盲犬獨自旅行。他以前抽菸，但十年前就戒菸了。上週，他搭渡輪到一座島，在海灘上散步。他的腳跟被石頭割傷，傷口紅了起來。護理師仔細清理傷口以免感染，現在已經好轉了。

items.promptZh: 我喝熱湯時燙到了舌頭。
referenceEn: I burned my tongue when I drank the hot soup.
The hot soup burned my tongue.
rubricZh: tongue 表示「舌頭」，例如 burn my tongue 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式）

items.promptZh: 那隻導盲犬幫助失明的主人過馬路。
referenceEn: The guide dog helps its blind owner cross the street.
The guide dog helped its blind owner cross the road.
rubricZh: 用 blind 表示「失明的」（例如 its blind owner）
「導盲犬」可寫，例如 guide dog 等；時態可用 helps、helped 等
